web-console.description: Hosts supervisor terminal sessions; the desk creates a session and types the two launch messages and control slash commands, only on an operator tap.
web-console.degraded_behavior: Launch is manual: the desk shows the stance message and kernel to paste. Pause, resume and stop say Web Console is unavailable. Reading research state is unaffected.

uses.name: Automatic launch
uses.description: Create a Codex session through the governed launcher and send the stance message and goal kernel

uses.name: Pause, resume, stop
uses.description: Type /goal pause, /goal resume or quit Codex in a supervisor session on the operator's tap

vrooli-events.description: Carries the courier's decision and notice events to Notification Hub (research_desk.needs_you.decision_requested.v1 and .notification.v1), the route every scenario-originated decision takes.
vrooli-events.degraded_behavior: Nothing is sent; the desk says why in the needs-you feed and the operator answers in the desk. The scheduler's own delivery covers items without a delivered entry.

uses.name: Decision events
uses.description: Publish needs-you decisions and notices for Notification Hub

data-backup-manager.description: Registers the research home that the desk owns as a filesystem backup target.
data-backup-manager.degraded_behavior: Research remains available; the live desk retries target registration while Data Backup Manager is unavailable.

uses.name: Research home backup
uses.description: Register the desk's research home for scheduled recovery snapshots

notification-hub.description: Shows needs-you items on the operator's phone as decision asks or plain notices; the courier reads asks, notices and answers back (reads need no credential).
notification-hub.degraded_behavior: Needs-you items stay in the desk and in the research files; the operator answers them in the desk, and the courier sends them on its next pass once the Hub answers.

uses.name: Decision delivery
uses.description: Raise one ask per needs-you item with a recommendation, or a plain notice for the rest, when the operator's courier switch is on; both go out as events through vrooli-events

uses.name: Answer read-back
uses.description: Read answered asks back into OPERATOR.md and record delivery; an ask the desk no longer needs stays open until its deadline

service.name: research-desk
service.description: Configure, launch, watch, steer and review supervised research from a phone, without being in the research loop.

courier_switches.rationale: The operator's courier switches per commission and for global items, with when each was turned on. Losing it turns delivery off.

budget.rationale: A few hundred bytes per commission; alarm-only because it records operator choices.

first_sightings.rationale: When each needs-you item was first found. An item first sighted before its switch was turned on is never sent; deleting the file would make old items look new, so it is never removed by a sweep.

budget.rationale: One line per open item; items that leave the files are forgotten. Alarm-only.

looks.rationale: The operator's recorded looks (mark-seen), one JSON file per commission or topic; `changes` reports from them. Deleting one resets its 'since'.

budget.rationale: One small file per commission or topic. Alarm-only because the looks are operator history.

launch_tests.rationale: One report per launch test run against a throwaway session; the newest is read by GetLaunchTest.

budget.rationale: A report is a few kilobytes and the operator starts each test; alarm-only because the reports are evidence.

instance_lock.rationale: Empty lock file held by the one desk instance allowed to write.

retention.rationale: Shared storage retention enforcement writes the latest compact receipt under the desk's state namespace.

budget.rationale: The receipt is bounded regenerable operational state and is replaced on each enforcement run.

storage.rationale: The desk writes only its state namespace; the research home under ~/.vrooli/research belongs to the operator's research skills and is not claimed here.
